name: missing_passage
description: Audio-only intro (publisher announcement) before the text, and an ebook paragraph that the narrator skipped entirely.
segments: Nobody in the village remembered when the stranger first arrived.
He simply appeared one morning at the baker's door, asking for bread and directions to the coast.
The baker's wife later swore that his shoes were dry although it had rained all night, that his coat smelled of cedar and smoke, and that he paid with a coin nobody could identify.
These details grew with every telling until the stranger had become, in the village memory, half a saint and half a thief.
The road to the coast was long and empty, and the gulls followed him all the way to the cliffs.
